text: かたを　くんで　たのしそうに　わらってる！

structure.en: with arms around each other's shoulders

structure.jp: たのしそうに　わらってる！

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, here showing the pose they are in while the next thing happens. かたを　くんで = 'with arms around each other's shoulders'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks)
patterns.explanation: そう put on an adjective with its last い dropped means 'looks'; with に it tells how an action is done. たのしそうに = 'looking like they're having fun'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: わらってる is the short spoken form of わらっている, which says the action is going on now. わらってる = 'are laughing'.
